wiki.title: Tim Moffitt
wiki.extract: Timothy Douglas Moffitt (born 1964/1965) is a Republican member of the North Carolina Senate who has represented the 48th district since 2023. He was previously in the North Carolina House of Representatives representing the 117th district from 2020 to 2023 and the 116th district from 2011 to 2015.
